details.description: grok-4.20-non-reasoning-gv2 is one of xAI's alias names for the non-reasoning variant of Grok 4.20: xAI's own model documentation lists 'grok-4.20-non-reasoning-gv2' alongside the plain and '-latest' names as an id for the same model, without describing any functional difference between them. Like the rest of the non-reasoning family, it answers without an extended reasoning step, takes text and image input and returns text, and supports function calling and structured (JSON) outputs over a 1,000,000-token context window.
advantages: Supports function calling and structured (JSON) outputs (xAI model documentation).
Takes a 1,000,000-token context window with combined text and image input (xAI model documentation).
Answers directly without an extended reasoning step ('Reasoning: No' per xAI's own model documentation).
disadvantages: Does not perform extended reasoning ('Reasoning: No' per xAI's own model documentation), unlike the reasoning and multi-agent Grok 4.20 variants.
xAI's own documentation does not explain what distinguishes the 'gv2' alias from the plain or '-latest' non-reasoning names.

Artificial Analysis lists the non-reasoning Grok 4.20 model as deprecated and names xAI's newer Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning) as a replacement to consider instead, although xAI's own current model page carries no deprecation notice.
use_cases: Low-latency chat and agentic tool-calling that does not need an extended reasoning step
Structured-output (JSON) generation and function calling inside an application
Tasks that combine text and image input with a fast, direct response

notes: Identified via xAI's own docs, which list 'grok-4.20-non-reasoning-gv2' as an alias of the non-reasoning Grok 4.20 model but do not explain the 'gv2' label. Artificial Analysis separately scores a distinct 'Grok 4.20 0309 v2 (Non-reasoning)' entry (Intelligence Index 14) alongside a plain 'Grok 4.20 0309 (Non-reasoning)' entry (Intelligence Index 15), which may correspond to gv2 vs. the base snapshot, but I could not confirm this mapping on any maker page, so I did not state it as fact. Catalog facts (1,000,000-token max input/output, image+text in/out) match xAI's own model page; Artificial Analysis separately states a 2,000,000-token context window, which I did not use per instructions to keep the catalog's value. This target, grok-4.20-non-reasoning and grok-4.20-non-reasoning-latest are three separate catalog slugs xAI's own docs list as aliases of the same underlying model.
